We need to generate new test cases for debug method, avoiding duplication. Existing cases cover:

- standard non-null all arguments
- node null
- rootNode null
- at empty string
- at with special characters

Potential other cases: logger null? but logger is required; maybe logger is a mock that throws? Could test with at being null (not covered). Also test with both node and rootNode null. Also test with logger that is a spy to verify call count. Also test with at being whitespace string. Also test with logger that is a real logger but verify that no exception thrown. Also test with node being a complex JsonNode (e.g., array, object) to see toString representation? But debug just passes node objects; logger formatting uses {} placeholders which call toString. Could test with node being an empty object node, rootNode being empty array. Also test with logger debug disabled (i.e., logger.isDebugEnabled() false) - but method always calls logger.debug; but if logger is mock, we can set behavior. However debug method just calls logger.debug; we can test that it is called regardless of isDebugEnabled? Usually SLF4J logger.debug will check internally; but we can verify that method is called.

Thus create new group "debugMethodEdgeCases". Cases:

1. both node and rootNode null, at non-null.
2. at null.
3. at whitespace string.
4. node is an empty ObjectNode, rootNode is an empty ArrayNode, at normal path.
5. logger is null -> method will throw NullPointerException. Should test exception.

Check if method is static, so we can call directly. If logger null, logger.debug will NPE. So expected exception.

Also test with logger that throws RuntimeException when debug called to ensure propagation.

Maybe add case where logger is a mock with debug method throwing exception; expected exception.

Thus produce JSON with group "debugMethodAdditionalTests". Provide cases.

Make sure format matches required: list of groups each with "group" and "cases". Input list of parameter objects.

We'll need to represent parameter values as strings referencing mock objects like "mockLoggerNull", "emptyObjectNode", etc.

Provide expected description.
